topic: Project Northstar Week 3 interim steering decision
audience: CFO, Group Treasurer, and Steering Committee members who need a concise decision, its evidence limits, and named next actions
objective: Secure alignment on a conditional federated design direction and a 90-day evidence-mobilization plan without implying execution, funding, or value approval
thesis: Federated coordination is the best-supported direction for controlled learning because it combines a common data/control spine with explicit local rights, but seven open gates, zero validated value, and unavailable cost keep every production and funding decision closed.

narrative_arc.purpose: State the decision and authorization boundary.
Show what is known, what it does not prove, and why federated is the conditional leader.
Map the future-state decision chain and the two bounded evidence designs.
Keep value types separate and state what would change the direction.
Convert open risks into accountable evidence work and return to the opening decision.

slide_plan.message: Advance federated coordination only for evidence mobilization; retain and hold the two alternatives.
slide_plan.visual_strategy: Dark command-center opener with advance / retain / hold posture and a visible no-authorization strip.

slide_plan.message: The evidence is concentrated and decision-useful, but it proves neither cash mobility nor removable effort.
slide_plan.visual_strategy: Lab-results ledger pairing four diagnostic facts with permitted and prohibited inference.
slide_plan.outline_title: The evidence points to concentrated friction, not a proven benefit

slide_plan.message: Federated is the robust directional leader, but open non-compensating gates control the decision.
slide_plan.visual_strategy: Editable score chart with a gate ledger and no confidence or value encoding.
slide_plan.outline_title: Federated leads at 87—subject to seven open gates

slide_plan.message: A common global spine can standardize evidence and decisions while preserving governed local rights.
slide_plan.visual_strategy: Five-layer operating ledger functioning as the system map; enterprise standard and local right remain distinct.
slide_plan.outline_title: One global spine can preserve local rights while tightening the decision chain

slide_plan.message: Visibility testing must start with a controlled 55-account census and remain read-only for the 10-account cohort.
slide_plan.visual_strategy: Table-first readiness dashboard with cohort, protected case, KPI, and rollback evidence.
slide_plan.outline_title: Visibility readiness starts with 55-account control, then a 10-account read-only test

slide_plan.message: The payment frame is built to diagnose evidence-backed causes, not estimate enterprise prevalence or savings.
slide_plan.visual_strategy: Compact sample equation and matching-quality readout using editable tables.
slide_plan.outline_title: Payment v3 uses 120 paired reviews to diagnose causes

slide_plan.message: Cash, P&L, capacity, and risk remain separate ledgers with zero recognized value today.
slide_plan.visual_strategy: Compact four-row value ledger without a total or benefit hero.
slide_plan.outline_title: Four value ledgers stay separate; recognized value remains zero

slide_plan.message: The manager downside preserves only the design direction; explicit ownership and affordability failures force a switch.
slide_plan.visual_strategy: Open two-column falsification test linked by a non-compensating gate hinge.
slide_plan.outline_title: The downside preserves the direction, while ownership and affordability can force a switch

slide_plan.message: Five accountable evidence packages, all open or blocked, now control any launch or investment decision.
slide_plan.visual_strategy: Board risk ledger with package, owner, evidence, and categorical status; no averaged readiness score.
slide_plan.outline_title: Five owner-led evidence packages now gate launch and funding

slide_plan.message: A 90-day evidence timebox should end in another decision, not an automatic launch.
slide_plan.visual_strategy: Four report bands with an EVIDENCE ONLY rail and a final stop / extend / later-pilot gate.
slide_plan.source_status: analyst mobilization proposal grounded in existing stage gates
slide_plan.outline_title: Use 90 days to make the next decision evidence-ready, then return for go/no-go

design_notes.primary_grammar: Board risk memo using board-ledger page system
design_notes.secondary_grammar: Lab-results evidence tables for diagnostic, pilot, and value slides
design_notes.conclusion_loop: Slide 10 repeats slide 1's direction, owner assignment, and reserved approvals after showing the evidence.
design_notes.system_map: Slide 4 is the early decision-chain map; later pilot and evidence slides zoom into its nodes.
design_notes.falsification: Slide 8 states the downside and observable switching conditions before the close.
design_notes.rhythm: title → results ledger → score chart → system ledger → two lab readouts → value ledger → open comparison → risk ledger → banded timeline
prohibited_moves: no map or decorative imagery without evidence
no execution arrow at the end
no value or confidence interpretation of the option scores
